build_get_custom_mask: build a causal attention mask for SSD decoding using get_custom_mask with context lengths, step, K, and cache hits
create_get_mask_iter_i: create an iteration-specific attention mask tensor given prefix length, K, and F parameters
run_flat_blocks_after_cat: run flat_blocks_after_cat to concatenate variable-length prefix blocks with a constant block into a flat boolean tensor
create_get_custom_mask_vectorized: create a vectorized causal mask for batch sizes greater than 8 using hit/miss glue mask fixup
create_get_custom_mask_cached: create a cached causal mask using precomputed glue, diagonal, and ones components for batch sizes up to 8
